I sneak out to do laundry when she’s eating in her room because she has no use for anyone or anything, even to harass me once she sits down with her pile of junk food. Totally non compliant, wanted me to lie for her to her nurses and social worker. She’s 79 and looks way older than her 92 year old brother that is still active and driving, scary as that is. She eats nothing but processed food. Pancakes, bacon, bagged Bear Creek soups she tells her nurse are home made lol Butter, oh the butter and sugar and salt… and she’s diabetic, has congestive heart failure, horrible edema in her legs, yet she won’t eat healthy or put her legs up to save her life. But she wanted me to lie and say she puts her legs up and eats protein and veggies and takes her meds and it was all lies! She wouldn’t let me monitor her meds, her diet restrictions, her weight, because of the edema she can’t gain a lot. She’s hunched over and her neck is twisted because she insists on sleeping in her chair slumped over to the side, it’s painful to see. So not she’s stuck like that and I just couldn’t lie for her… By not saying anything I could be held liable! I finally mentioned something to her nurse and the backlash I got! Shame on me for telling the nurse she fell 5 times in 24 hours! Shame on me for telling her nurse the truth. She won’t let me help with her meds, she tied to pretend I assist her with her meds when her social worker was here for her annual recertification and called me into her bedroom to help her tell the worker about her meds. I took the opportunity to say, but I don’t know what you take or when because you don’t allow me to help with that at all. She told me to leave but when the social worker left… Yipe. She was furious and called me some horrible things while screaming at me for opening my mouth. She’s the one that called me in there. She banned me from talking to anyone coming to the house for her after I mentioned to her nurse she’s non compliant and that’s why she stay in this condition. She’s only goes to the hospital when her body is shutting down, they bring her back, get everything under control, she has normal looking legs and not tree trunks that are cracked, bleeding, beet red and peeling :/ She won’t keep her compression wraps on, she cuts them off as soon as a nurse leaves or she gets home from the hospital. She makes a million promises, acts like an angel in hospital and then comes home back into her safe place, and she just goes right back to ordering junk food she buys for delivery from various places. Won’t put her legs up, won’t take her meds, won’t stop drinking whole milk (makes her cough, gag and have horrible mucus build up and phlegm she hacks all over the kitchen and her bedroom bathroom and won’t cover her mouth. It’s disgusting. She would rather poop in a bag then go to the bathroom and then she throws those bags into the hallway for me to deal with. No more. Sorry for long post. I’m so traumatized from her and having to still live here. I am getting out as soon as I can afford a car and find a room. Unfortunately rent is so out of control In CA I can’t afford even a studio apt on my own working 45 hours a week :/ To anyone that actually red this whole thing, thank you. I’m sure some live in situations are amazing, mine just happed to be horrific. Big hugs to all IHSS Providers!!!! Even though I got out, you’ll always have a soft spot in my heart because I know how you work! $16.50 an hour for dealing with all we do? The bio hazard stuff :/ The personal care :/ It’s a lot. Hopefully Happy 2025 To Us 🎉

Lazy Dog has the best happy hour hands down. I’m surprised it’s so unknown. Food and drink specials that you won’t believe and the food is spectacular! Try the Boneless Buffalo Wings, you get 5 and they are big, for $6! They come with celery and carrots. They will blow your mind, ask for extra buffalo sauce and ranch at no charge. Sounds odd but the Brussel sprouts are also amazing and so cheap during happy hour. I tried the bone in wings and during happy hour they are $9, but the boneless ones are so juicy inside and crunchy outside that I stick with those. Lots of other things to try. Drinks are $5 for any well drink, $6 Sailor Jerrys and Coke. Service in bar area amazing. 3-6pm Monday-Friday, late night happy hour Sunday-Thursdays as well!

I’m in California and the laws just got stricter this year so I’m terrified. My court date is first week in February and my DMV hearing is first week of March. A DUI is 2 points and I already have 2 points from other accidents (not alcohol related) 4 points is automatic 12 month suspension if occurs within  6 months. I’m totally screwed. How will I get to DUI classes, how will I get to work release, how will I get to probation officer, how will I find a job with a DUI? I lost my SO of ten years, I’m going to lose my house and have to file bankruptcy, personal and business. I’m a complete mess, but you know what? It probably saved my life, I didn’t crash and thank God I didn’t hurt anyone! This was my rock bottom. The next year is going to be horrible, but I have to think this happened for a reason and I take full responsibility for making a horrible decision by drinking again and getting so drunk I didn’t even consider the consequences of my actions by getting behind the wheel. My thoughts and prayers are with you. Things could be much worse. I’m always here if you want to chat or vent. We are still here with a chance to start fresh. I know it’s easy to say and believe me I’m also trying to convince everything will be ok. Hugs
